title: Yo YouTube (by way of TikTok) I Love Being a Parent

top_liked.author: @kariannecrysler
top_liked.text: I loved it when the boys started choosing their own types of music. I got to see their personalities grow through it & they got to teach me things about their world. I absolutely cherish the moments like this 💗🤘

top_liked.author: @MonkeyAtTypewriter
top_liked.text: Awwww. I have a 4 year old. He is really effected by music and it's wild to see that develop. I'm so happy for you, looking forward to that point  😀

top_liked.author: @chasson321
top_liked.text:
One of the greatest joys of being a parent is when your child/children have the confidence of sharing anything with you. That they are unafraid that you will not judge them harshly reaffirms that you just might have done something right in raising them. 
Relish these moments.

top_liked.text: Love that! A little bit of that is going on over here with my teenagers ❤️
